groups.activity: Howl of the Kubrow, then Incubator access

rows.label: Howl of the Kubrow
rows.note: after the Venus Junction, from the Codex; gives the Incubator Segment

conditions: During the quest the first den drops an egg 100% of the time and incubation takes 60 seconds; that first hatch is still a random breed.
The collar comes once from the quest and covers every later Kubrow.
Consigning an unwanted Kubrow to the Lotus for 25,000 credits is the only way to free its slot; take its two imprints first.
The blueprint is a reusable 50,000-credit Market purchase; every incubation consumes a core, win or lose.
bonuses: Build the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment early if you expect several rolls; it halves incubation and its recipe takes one Power Core.

rows.label: Huras Kubrow
rows.note: equal odds among Huras, Raksa, Sahasa, Sunika, Chesa
rows.alt: use two Huras Genetic Code Templates

conditions: Random Incubation has no weighting and no pity; streaks of four or five of the same wrong breed get reported.
Two Huras imprints make Huras the likely result, but the wiki says it still isn't guaranteed, and the egg and core are still consumed.
Incubation is 48 hours, or 24 with the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment.
Mature the pup manually in the Incubator (instant) before it can go on missions.
bonuses: Breeders often hand out spare imprints free; Huras imprints are tradeable, two per Kubrow at 1.5 hours each.
Its Huras Claws level but give no Mastery; only the Kubrow counts.

disclosures.title: ask for imprints instead of rolling
disclosures.body: Several veterans in one thread offered imprints to a stranger unprompted, and one player bought Huras imprints because it was their last missing breed. Two matching imprints turn a 1-in-5 roll into the likely outcome at the same egg-and-core cost as one random attempt. Empty Genetic Code Templates build from a reusable 50,000-credit Market blueprint.
